rules.definition: Canonical UTF-8 JSON and canonical TLV bytes only
Counter mutations use Increment with delta exactly one
Counter and metric identifiers are disjoint
Metric reset behavior is Never, Generation, or Explicit
Argument vectors are bounded ordered byte strings without shell reconstruction
Entrypoint interpreter key, path, and digest match supported-build bindings
Windows and repository paths use their declared canonical grammar
Each resource row has exactly thirteen ordered fields
Resource cardinality is positive and bounded
SupportedBuildEntryV1 has field IDs one through forty-one
Windows upcase tables join only on supportedBuildKey
FILE_ID_INFO uses volume serial U64 and opaque sixteen-byte file identifier
Broker process and worker ACE masks are exact unsigned 32-bit values
LUID is encoded as unsigned 64-bit big-endian bytes
supportedBuildKey uniquely identifies a supported-build row
Entrypoint interpreter bindings match path and image digest
Deadline relation is strict less-than
Capacity relation is less-than-or-equal
W is the exact R6 ordered checked sum including the topology term twice
VT policy is raise-only
RSA1 envelope is exactly 512 bytes with exponent 65537 only
Trust epoch satisfies notBefore less than notAfter
Trust roles are HostEvidence and RecoveryAuthority
Digest is SHA256(ASCII domain || NUL || meta digest || schema digest || canonical TLV)
Artifact paths are strict repository-relative forward-slash paths
GUID text is lowercase D, nonnil, with RFC4122 network bytes
Fixed Unicode tables contain NFC and CS0 kinds
Windows upcase table is keyed by supportedBuildKey
Entrypoint root <=1MiB, aggregate <=2MiB, source sites <=256, user arguments <=128

keyId.formula: lowercase SHA256 of all 512 RSA envelope bytes

membershipPathGrammar.TrustedWorkflowRevision: tracked selected-revision artifact under certification/ satisfying TCAST-PATH-001
